name: Migajas
description: A privacy-focused, multi-user note-taking app with a Go backend and SvelteKit frontend. Features rich text editing, secret notes with AES-256-GCM encryption, file attachments, voice memos, and multi-user support with JWT authentication.

notes.text: On first access, you will be prompted to create the admin account via the setup wizard.
Self-registration is disabled by default. Enable it via the admin panel or by setting ALLOW_SELF_REGISTRATION=true in /opt/migajas/.env
